modules.title: Introduction to Computer System Components
modules.html:
Hardware and software, input, output and storage devices. This section covers introduction to computer system components.

Key points

  • Malicious software designed to infiltrate or damage a computer system is called _____. — Malware.
  • Which device is used to protect a computer system from power surges — UPS.
  • The brain of the computer system is the _____. — CPU.
  • A software program designed to damage or gain unauthorized access to a computer system is... — Malware.
  • The binary system uses only the digits _____. — 0 and 1.

Worked examples

Q: Malicious software designed to infiltrate or damage a computer system is called _____.
A: Malware — Malware is a broad term that includes viruses, worms, trojans, and spyware.

Q: Which device is used to protect a computer system from power surges?
A: UPS — An Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) provides battery backup when the electrical power fails or drops to an unacceptable voltage level.

Which device is used to protect a computer system from power surges?

quiz.q: Malicious software designed to infiltrate or damage a computer system is called _____.
quiz.solution: Malware is a broad term that includes viruses, worms, trojans, and spyware.

quiz.q: Which device is used to protect a computer system from power surges?
quiz.solution: An Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) provides battery backup when the electrical power fails or drops to an unacceptable voltage level.

quiz.q: The brain of the computer system is the _____.
quiz.solution: The Central Processing Unit (CPU) is often referred to as the brain because it executes instructions and coordinates all activities.

quiz.q: A software program designed to damage or gain unauthorized access to a computer system is...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Malware.

quiz.q: The binary system uses only the digits _____.
quiz.solution: Binary is a base-2 number system representing values using only 0 (off) and 1 (on).

quiz.q: The first phase of the System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) is _____.
quiz.solution: SDLC typically begins with Preliminary Investigation or Feasibility Study to determine if the project is worth pursuing.

quiz.q: Which of the following is a database management system (DBMS)?
quiz.solution: Microsoft Access is a pseudo-relational database management system.

quiz.q: A computer on a network that requests resources is called a _____.
quiz.solution: In a client-server model, the client requests services and the server fulfills them.

quiz.q: The brain of the computer is the:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Processor/CPU.

quiz.q: Which of these is System Software?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Linux.

quiz.q: The physical parts of a computer are called:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Hardware.

quiz.q: Who is known as the father of the computer?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Charles Babbage.

quiz.q: The binary system uses:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: 0 and 1.

quiz.q: Father of Computer:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Charles Babbage.

quiz.q: Which part of the computer is responsible for displaying the visual output?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Monitor.

quiz.q: A computer network within a building is called:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: LAN.

quiz.q: Which of these is an example of System Software?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Operating System.

quiz.q: The base of the hexadecimal number system is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: 16.

quiz.q: Who is the Father of Computer?
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Charles Babbage.

quiz.q: Which generation of computers introduced the use of Microprocessors?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Fourth.

quiz.q: Which network topology connects all devices to a single central cable?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Bus.

quiz.q: Which unit of storage is the largest among these?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Terabyte.

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT a search engine?

quiz.q: The pictorial representation of an algorithm is:

quiz.q: WAN:

quiz.q: OR Gate:
